episodes.name: January 5, 2026
episodes.overview: Raw on Netflix goes Upside Down with "Stranger Things" for the one-year anniversary. CM Punk defends the World Heavyweight Title against Bron Breakker.

episodes.name: January 12, 2026
episodes.overview: "The Phenomenal" AJ Styles looks to topple "The Ring General" Gunther when Raw returns to Germany for the first time in nearly three decades.

episodes.name: January 19, 2026
episodes.overview: CM Punk defends the World Heavyweight Title in Belfast against Ireland's own Finn Bálor. Becky Lynch and Maxxine Dupri clash in a title rematch.

episodes.name: January 26, 2026
episodes.overview: Raw General Manager Adam Pearce confronts the suspended Bron Breakker. A Fatal 4-Way Match determines the new World Tag Team Title No. 1 Contenders.

episodes.name: February 2, 2026
episodes.overview: Roman Reigns looks ahead to WrestleMania 42. Stephanie Vaquer defends the Women's World Title against Raquel Rodriguez in a Philly Street Fight.

episodes.name: February 9, 2026
episodes.overview: The Usos defend the World Tag Team Title against the newly crowned No. 1 Contenders, Alpha Academy. Elimination Chamber Match Qualifiers roll on.

episodes.name: February 16, 2026
episodes.overview: The Men's and Women's Elimination Chamber Matches continue to take shape with two more Qualifying Matches. AJ Lee arrives on Raw.

episodes.name: February 23, 2026
episodes.overview: Atlanta celebrates the phenomenal career of AJ Styles. The two final qualifiers round out the Elimination Chamber Matches.

episodes.name: March 2, 2026
episodes.overview: Roman Reigns returns to Raw following Elimination Chamber. Dominik Mysterio defends the Intercontinental Title against Penta.

episodes.name: March 9, 2026
episodes.overview: Oba Femi and Rusev collide in a clash of WWE powerhouses.  Six Superstars compete in a Gauntlet Match to decide AJ Lee's next challenger.

episodes.name: March 16, 2026
episodes.overview: Raw celebrates 316 Day, Roman Reigns returns and Bayley challenges AJ Lee for the Women's Intercontinental Championship.

episodes.name: March 23, 2026
episodes.overview: Brock Lesnar emerges in Boston after Oba Femi accepts his WrestleMania 42 Open Challenge.  The Usos collide with Logan Paul & Austin Theory.

episodes.name: March 30, 2026
episodes.overview: The Usos throw down with Logan Paul & Austin Theory in a World Tag Team Title Street Fight at Madison Square Garden in New York City.

episodes.name: April 6, 2026
episodes.overview: World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk emerges at Toyota Center as The Road to WrestleMania 42 runs through Houston.

episodes.name: April 13, 2026
episodes.overview: Days before CM Punk defends the World Heavyweight Title against Roman Reigns, the final Raw before WrestleMania 42 emanates from Sacramento, Calif.

episodes.name: April 20, 2026
episodes.overview: On the Raw after WrestleMania, World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns and The Usos came face-to-face with Jacob Fatu. Plus, Oba Femi declared his arrival after slaying Brock Lesnar at WrestleMania, Sol Ruca and Ethan Page debuted, The Street Profits returned to brawl with The Vision as Bron Breakker unleashed a brutal beatdown on Seth Rollins and more.

episodes.name: April 27, 2026
episodes.overview: After Jacob Fatu attacked World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns, The OTC accepted the challenge from The Samoan Werewolf. Plus, Asuka assaulted IYO SKY during SKY’s title match against Women’s Intercontinental Champion Becky Lynch, Seth Rollins challenged Bron Breakker to a match at Backlash and more!

episodes.name: May 4, 2026
episodes.overview: On the final Raw before WWE Backlash, Jacob Fatu delivered a painful statement to The OTC. Plus, Bron Breakker unleashed two attacks on Seth Rollins, Oba Femi began his Open Challenge with a victory over Otis, and so much more.

episodes.name: May 11, 2026
episodes.overview: On the Raw after WWE Backlash, Jacob Fatu showed up at Roman Reigns’ Acknowledgment Ceremony, only to lay waste to Roman Reigns and The Usos. Plus, The Judgment Day’s attacked WWE Women’s Tag Team Champions Paige & Brie Bella, Dominik Mysterio made history by successfully defended  the AAA Mega Championship against “Original” El Grande Americano, Oba Femi forced Los Garza into the Open Challenge, and more.

episodes.name: May 18, 2026
episodes.overview: Seth Rollins got backup from The Street Profits, but all three were beaten down by Bron Breakker and the rest of The Vision. Plus, Brock Lesnar returned to F-5 Oba Femi, Jacob Fatu challenged World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns to Tribal Combat and so much more!

episodes.name: May 25, 2026
episodes.overview: On the final Raw before WWE Clash in Italy, Roman Reigns and Jacob Fatu came face-to-face prior to their World Heavyweight Championship Tribal Combat Match this Sunday. Plus, Intercontinental Champion Penta defendeds his title against Je’Von Evans, Oba Femi confronts Paul Heyman en route to his rematch with Brock Lesnar and more.

episodes.name: June 1, 2026
episodes.overview: Following the chaos at WWE Clash in Italy, the Superstars of Raw take over Turin's Inalpi Arena. The King and Queen of the Ring Tournaments begin.

episodes.name: June 8, 2026
episodes.overview: The King and Queen of the Ring Tournaments continue in Paris, France, with two First Round Fatal 4-Way Matches.

episodes.name: June 15, 2026
episodes.overview: The King and Queen of the Ring Tournament Semifinals get underway with Oba Femi opposing Dominik Mysterio and IYO SKY facing Raquel Rodriguez.

episodes.name: June 22, 2026
episodes.overview: Brie Bella & Paige defend the WWE Women's Tag Tag Championship against Bayley & Lyra Valkyria in London.

episodes.name: June 29, 2026
episodes.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns returns. The Superstars of Raw arrive in Atlantic City, N.J., to face the fallout from WWE Night of Champions.

episodes.name: July 6, 2026
episodes.overview: The Street Profits defend the World Tag Team Title against Bron Breakker and Austin Theory in a championship rematch.

episodes.name: July 13, 2026
episodes.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns appears in Dallas. Seven Superstars compete in an Intercontinental Title No. 1 Contender's Gauntlet Match.

episodes.name: July 20, 2026
episodes.overview: With SummerSlam fast approaching, Seth Rollins appears on Raw prior to challenging Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight Title.

episodes.name: July 27, 2026
episodes.overview: Oba Femi and Brock Lesnar brace for the Hell in a Cell weigh-in. Roman Reigns and Seth Rollins meet face-to-face ahead of SummerSlam.

episodes.name: August 3, 2026
episodes.overview: Superstars face the fallout from a historic two-night SummerSlam, including the Hell in a Cell battle and the World Heavyweight Title bout.

episodes.name: August 10, 2026
episodes.overview: Contenders emerge with their sights set on Women's World Champion Liv Morgan and an opportunity at the coveted title.

episodes.name: August 17, 2026
episodes.overview: Solo Sikoa is delivered to Roman Reigns. The World Heavyweight Title No. 1 Contender Tournament continues.
